title: Crops and the country that grows the most

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

top_producer.statement: {value} grows more {label} than any other country.
top_producer.match: Match each crop to the country that grows the most of it.
top_producer.all: Tap all {n} crops that {value} grows the most of.

rows.label: Apples
rows.description: edible fruit of the apple tree
rows.hook: is a crisp fruit that grows on trees and comes in red, green or yellow varieties

rows.label: Bananas
rows.description: elongated, edible fruit produced by several kinds of large herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa
rows.hook: is a curved yellow fruit that grows in bunches called hands on tall plants

rows.label: Corn
rows.description: species of grass cultivated as a food crop
rows.hook: grows on tall stalks with kernels packed onto a cob wrapped in husks

rows.label: Avocados
rows.description: species of plant, use Q961769 for the fruit
rows.hook: is a pear-shaped fruit with buttery green flesh around one large pit, and browns fast once cut open

rows.label: Potatoes
rows.description: species of plant (for the food, use Q16587531)
rows.hook: is a starchy tuber that grows underground and gets mashed, fried or baked whole

rows.label: Tomatoes
rows.description: type of plant species with edible, often red, berry fruit
rows.hook: is a juicy red fruit often mistaken for a vegetable and used in sauces and salads

rows.label: Quinoa
rows.hook: is a tiny protein-rich seed cooked like a grain and popular in health-food bowls

rows.label: Peanuts
rows.description: legume cultivated for use of the underground seedpods as a grain crop, and also processed as peanut oil
rows.hook: grows underground in pods despite being called a nut, and gets pressed into a creamy spread

rows.label: Figs
rows.hook: is a soft, seed-filled fruit often dried and eaten with cheese or in preserves

rows.label: Sweet potatoes
rows.hook: is an orange-fleshed root vegetable often roasted or mashed for holiday meals

rows.label: Cloves
rows.hook: is a dried aromatic flower bud used whole or ground in warm spice blends

rows.label: Wheat
rows.hook: is a cereal grain milled into flour for bread, pasta and countless baked goods

rows.label: Black pepper
rows.hook: is a dried berry ground into the world's most common savory table seasoning

rows.label: Oranges
rows.description: citrus fruit of the orange tree
rows.hook: is a round citrus fruit prized for its juice and segmented, easy-peel flesh

rows.label: Barley
rows.hook: is a cereal grain malted for brewing beer and whisky or added to hearty soups

rows.label: Strawberries
rows.description: hybrid species in the rose family
rows.hook: is a heart-shaped red berry covered in tiny seeds on its outer skin

rows.label: Kiwifruit
rows.description: edible berry of several species of woody vines in the genus Actinidia, native to India
rows.hook: is a fuzzy brown-skinned fruit with bright green flesh and tiny black seeds inside

rows.label: Mangoes
rows.hook: is a sweet tropical fruit with a large flat pit and juicy orange flesh

rows.label: Chickpeas
rows.hook: is a round legume ground into flour or blended into a creamy dip with tahini

rows.label: Chilli peppers
rows.description: fruit of plants from the genus Capsicum, members of the nightshade family, Solanaceae
rows.hook: is a spicy fruit ranging from mild to fiery, used fresh, dried or ground into hot sauce

rows.label: Tea
rows.hook: is a plant whose dried leaves are steeped in hot water to make a beloved hot beverage

rows.label: Almonds
rows.hook: is a tree nut often roasted as a snack or ground into a dairy-free milk

rows.label: Yams
rows.hook: is a rough-skinned starchy tuber often confused with a similar orange root vegetable

rows.label: Olives
rows.hook: is a small stone fruit cured and eaten whole or pressed into a rich cooking oil

rows.label: Ginger
rows.hook: is a knobby, spicy root used fresh, dried or pickled to add a warm bite to food

rows.label: Papayas
rows.hook: is a soft tropical fruit with orange flesh and a hollow center full of round black seeds

rows.label: Garlic
rows.description: species of plant (for the food, use Q21546392)
rows.hook: is a pungent bulb split into small cloves and used crushed or minced to season savory cooking

rows.label: Sugarcane
rows.description: several species of grass cultivated for sugar production
rows.hook: is a tall grass whose stalks are pressed and refined into common table sweetener

rows.label: Cherries
rows.hook: is a small stone fruit that ranges from tart to sweet and stains fingers red

rows.label: Cocoa beans
rows.description: fatty seed of Theobroma cacao which is the basis of chocolate
rows.hook: is the seed roasted and ground to make chocolate, found inside a large tree pod

rows.label: Grapes
rows.description: edible berry of a flowering plant in the family Vitaceae
rows.hook: is a small round fruit that grows in clusters on vines and gets pressed into wine

rows.label: Palm oil
rows.description: edible and biocombustible vegetable oil from fruit of oil palms
rows.hook: comes from the pressed fruit of a tropical tree and shows up in countless packaged snacks

rows.label: Hazelnuts
rows.hook: is a round tree nut often roasted and blended into a sweet chocolate spread

rows.label: Natural rubber
rows.description: polymers of the organic compound isoprene, with minor impurities of other organic compounds; refined from latex harvested from rubber trees
rows.hook: is a stretchy material tapped as milky sap from a tropical tree's bark

rows.label: Coffee beans
rows.hook: is the roasted seed ground and brewed to make the world's favorite morning pick-me-up drink
